members.title: Members
members.subtitle: The people who use this Mesbah and what each of them can do.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {name}?
deactivate.body: They can no longer sign in. Their projects, chats and versions stay as they are.

viewers.name: Viewer
viewers.can: Sees projects, their versions and their conversations.

reviewers.name: Reviewer
reviewers.can: Also chats with versions, corrects replies and approves them for training.

trainers.name: Trainer
trainers.can: Also downloads models, adds datasets, trains and exports.

admins.name: Administrator
admins.can: Also manages members, the system and the engines.

add.title: Add a member
add.passwordHint: At least 8 characters that are hard to guess.

errors.username_taken: That username is already in use.
errors.last_administrator: Mesbah needs at least one active administrator.
errors.owner_locked: The owner account stays an active administrator.
errors.self_deactivation: You can't deactivate your own account.
